title: Waves
tagline: Waves is a Decentralised Social Network built on Arbitrum Sepolia
description: Waves is a Decentralised Social Network built on Arbitrum. Project is currently deployed to Arbitrum Sepolia testnet. On Waves the users can do most things they usually do on social media like post content, like content, follow each other and bookmark. As it is decentralised, most content is immutable. Only bookmarks can be removed
how_its_made:
Waves is a Decentralised Social Network built on Arbitrum. Project is currently deployed to Arbitrum Sepolia testnet. 
Project is created using the Solidity programming language and the online remix ide.
While the frontend is not complete, it is built using html, css, javascript and the ethers library
